messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Enterprise POC (Helion Health) is asking for a hard no-preempt GPU guarantee for POC burst windows. They're proposing a 12mo committed spend (roughly $600k total). Need product + deal desk input on pricing uplift and approval path.
remy_sales_engineer: They want no-preempt during demo hours only (09:00-17:00 EST weekdays). That reduces packing efficiency but seems doable if we reserve a small dedicated pool.
jake_dealdesk: @maria_sales can you confirm exact number of GPUs and expected peak QPS? Need that to estimate uplift. @olivia_finance any ballpark on % uplift for non-preemptible carveouts vs standard reserved commit?
olivia_finance: Ballpark: dedicated non-preemptible pool + guaranteed burst availability typically carries an uplift in the range of ~18–28% over standard reserved pricing. With a 12mo term we can discount that to ~15% uplift if commit is firm. Need pool size (GPUs) and region to finalize.
sri_eng_runtime: Operational note: Non-preemptible means we must provision dedicated tiles with no preemption hooks — autoscale still possible but can't evict other tenants. This reduces multiplexing, increases idle capacity, and affects how we schedule KV cache placement. Recommend a 2-week POC canary to validate perf. Also we should define maintenance windows.
maria_sales: Customer insists on no fallback to preemptible during POC — demo must be rock-solid. They're ok with a short maintenance window notice.
jake_dealdesk: We can consider an exception if finance + infra + legal sign off. I'll need: exact GPU count, region, commit amount, and acceptance of maintenance window language. @legal_bot please draft suggested contract language.
legal_bot: Suggested clause: "Provider will allocate non-preemptible GPU capacity during agreed windows. Availability excludes scheduled maintenance windows (max 4 hours per quarter). If Provider fails to meet guaranteed availability, service credits apply per SLA."
remy_sales_engineer: Infra request snippet for provisioning ticket: ```yaml
pool_request:
  pool_type: dedicated_nonpreemptible
  region: us-east-1
  gpus: 16
  window: "09:00-17:00 EST Mon-Fri"
  autoscale: true
  burst_enabled: true
  fallback_policy: none
```
olivia_finance: If they sign a 12mo $600k commit and want 16 GPUs reserved during those windows, approving at +15% uplift would be within our typical carveout bands. Final approval requires confirmation of monthly burn profile. Also confirm capacity in us-east.
sri_eng_runtime: Capacity check: we can hold up to 32 dedicated non-preemptible GPUs in us-east without impacting existing customers, but provisioning lead time is ~10 business days. Ops will need the infra ticket and a scheduled maintenance window for the cutover.
jake_dealdesk: Action items: (1) @maria_sales confirm exact GPU count and commit signature by EOD; (2) @remy open infra ticket with the snippet above; (3) @olivia prepare final uplift quote and approval memo; (4) @legal_bot prepare amendment language for the SOW. I'll tag CRO if the net commit > $500k for exec sign-off.
maria_sales: @all :thumbsup: I'll validate numbers with the customer and get back today. If they confirm 16 GPUs / 12mo, we can proceed with the uplift path.
